title: 第812章 袭杀而至不平凡的旅程第811章 危级上升跨大陆的旅程
content_zh:
令狐黎在隔间里坐下，侧头看着窗外的云层从灰白色变成纯白，又从纯白变成一片辽阔的蓝灰色。
炎君和女帝在他隔壁，三人的隔间连在一起。
船上陆陆续续走动着其他乘客，脚步声和低语声交织在一起，顺着船舱的走廊传过来。
舰桥下方的货舱二层，四道身影无声地降落在飞船底层的平台边缘，落地时靴底与金属板面接触的声响被飞船引擎的低频运转声盖过，几乎没有惊动任何船舱中正在低头检查设备的工作人员。
他们穿着深灰色的紧身衣袍，面上覆着同样颜色的面罩，身形偏瘦，步伐轻盈，动作中没有多余摆动的痕迹。
他们在货舱阴影中站定，确认无人察觉，然后各自散开，朝着船上不同方向移动。
其中一人留在货舱入口处，另外三人朝上层乘客舱的方向移动，未携带任何显眼的武器，只在袖口和腰带处留有极细的凸起轮廓。
飞船上层的餐厅里，几个乘客正在低声交谈关于九天神国新皇登基的消息，暗网上已经公布，下一任新王即是——姚星耀。
餐厅角落靠近出口的位置，一个穿着深灰色外袍的人正独自坐在窗边，手里端着一杯已经不再冒热气的茶，视线没有落在任何交谈者身上，也没有朝船内的观察窗方向偏转。
他的目光每隔一段时间扫过餐厅入口，不规律，不快，让人很难判断他是在看人还是在看门。
另外两个灰袍人分散在走廊的阴影中。
......
飞云城港口
神君和邪帝二人注视着飞船起飞。
“放心吧，区区四个神境巅峰，令狐黎自己能对付。”邪帝从高台上跳下来，落在下面的石板地上，拍了拍手上不存在的灰尘，“走吧，去找薛听雨打听一下，这是个什么组织。”
他手里攥着一块破布，布料边缘还残留着干涸的血迹，上面绣着一个极小的暗纹标记。
这是从之前杀手衣服上撕下来的标识。
神君还站在高台上，没有立刻跟下来。他的目光还追着那道已经消失的航迹，语气沉重道：“令狐黎对付不了呢？炎君女帝才武士境。”
刚刚他和邪帝起了些许争执。
在神君看来应该把那四个神境巅峰也给杀了，可邪帝却不让了。

邪帝说是给他们的旅程添点惊喜，不然炎君女帝永远想不起他们身后站着谁。
他停下脚步，侧过头看了神君一眼。两人之间隔着几步的距离。
“那他们就可以大喊我的哥哥是神君和邪帝了。”邪帝笑了一下，没有表现出丝毫的担忧。
“你心真大。”神君无奈地叹了一口气。
......
飞船窗外的天色从灰蓝变成深蓝，又从深蓝过渡成一种带着紫色调的墨色。
船身稳定，引擎的低频轰鸣成为背景里持续不断的底噪。
餐厅里亮起了暖色的灯光，乘客们三三两两地落座，空气中弥漫着烤面包和炖肉的香气。
content_en:
Linghu Li sat down in the booth and turned his head to watch the clouds outside the window change from gray to pure white, and then from pure white to a vast blue-gray.
Yanjun and Empress were next to him, and their cubicles were connected together.
Other passengers were walking around on the ship one after another. Footsteps and whispers were intertwined and passed along the corridor of the cabin.
On the second floor of the cargo hold below the bridge, four figures landed silently on the edge of the platform at the bottom of the spacecraft. The sound of the contact between the soles of their boots and the metal plate when they landed was drowned out by the low-frequency running sound of the spacecraft engine. It hardly alerted any staff in the cabin who were looking down to check the equipment.
They were wearing dark gray tight-fitting robes, with masks of the same color covering their faces. They were slender and walked briskly, with no trace of unnecessary swings in their movements.
They stood still in the shadow of the cargo hold, making sure that no one was watching. Then they dispersed and moved in different directions on the ship.
One of them remained at the entrance to the cargo hold, while the other three moved towards the upper passenger compartment. They did not carry any conspicuous weapons, leaving only a very thin raised outline on the cuffs and waistband.
In the restaurant on the upper level of the spaceship, several passengers were chatting in low voices about the news of the new emperor of the Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom ascending to the throne. It has been announced on the dark web that the next new king is Yao Xingyao.
In the corner of the restaurant near the exit, a man in a dark gray robe was sitting alone by the window, holding a cup of tea that was no longer steaming. His eyes did not fall on any interlocutor, nor did he turn toward the observation window inside the ship.
His gaze swept across the entrance of the restaurant every once in a while, irregularly and unpleasantly, making it difficult to tell whether he was looking at people or the door.
Two other men in gray robes were scattered in the shadows of the corridor.
...
Feiyun City Port
The Shenjun and the Evil Emperor watched the spacecraft take off.
"Don't worry, Linghu Li can handle the four peak gods on his own." The Evil Emperor jumped down from the high platform, landed on the stone floor below, and patted the non-existent dust on his hands, "Let's go and find Xue Tingyu to find out what kind of organization this is."
He was holding a piece of rag in his hand, with dried blood still remaining on the edge of the cloth, and a tiny dark pattern mark embroidered on it.
This is a logo torn from the previous killer's clothes.
The Lord Shen was still standing on the high platform and did not follow immediately. His eyes were still chasing the disappeared flight path, and he said in a serious tone: "Why can't Linghu Li deal with it? Empress Yanjun is only at the warrior level."
He had a little dispute with the Evil Emperor just now.
In the opinion of the Divine Lord, those four peak divine realms should also be killed, but the Evil Emperor would not let them.
The Evil Emperor said that he wanted to add some surprises to their journey, otherwise Yanjun Empress would never remember who was standing behind them.
He stopped and turned his head to glance at Shenjun. There were a few steps between them.
"Then they can shout that my brother is the Divine Lord and the Evil Emperor." The Evil Emperor smiled and did not show the slightest concern.
"You have such a big heart." Shenjun sighed helplessly.
...
The sky outside the spacecraft window changed from gray-blue to dark blue, and then from dark blue to an ink color with a purple tint.
The hull is stable, and the low-frequency roar of the engine becomes a constant noise in the background.
Warm lights lit up in the restaurant, passengers sat down in twos and threes, and the aroma of baking bread and stew filled the air.
